prior_block:
PRICE PRIORS for recurring line types (statistical model fitted on the thresholds t revealed
in earlier games; gross amounts). How to use them:
- The amounts are final thresholds as they were revealed: they already contain whatever
  deductible, VAT and customary-price judgement applied in those cases, and they were computed
  from the full invoiced quantity (the whole quantity was indemnified there). For an
  indemnified line of this type take the stated amount for the line as t as it stands and give
  a price_log_sd that matches the stated range. Do not deduct a deductible from it and do not
  cut the invoiced quantity.
- Deviate only for something this case has and those cases did not: an aggregate cap or
  sub-limit that the lines of this invoice must share, a percentage reduction for a breached
  duty, or a purchase price or sum insured stated in the claim that limits the line.
- Whether a line is indemnified in THIS case is decided by the policy and the claim, not by
  the history. The history only says how often this line type was paid at all. A line type
  that was never indemnified before is usually an ancillary charge the policies do not carry;
  treat it as indemnified only if this policy clearly says so.
- line 3 "Vehicle costs": indemnified in 8 of 18 earlier cases, t = 0 in 10; when indemnified t per pc about 79 (80% range 69 to 89); revealed per pc: 34-45 (case 23*), 38-44 (case 25*), >=68 (case 18), >=76 (case 21), >=76 (case 21), >=76 (case 21) (* = other policy wording)

items.description: Leak detection and moisture measurement for kitchen sink supply leak, incl. technician labour and call-out
items.rationale: Policy covers investigation necessary to locate and identify the source of the damage and the measurements necessary to establish the extent of the moisture (7.1.7(e)). This is a single combined line for leak detection and moisture measurement, both of which are necessary and directly related to the covered escape of water event. Reference cases (21, 12) show similar lines indemnified at t >= 229 for leak detection call-out and t between 153-178 for moisture measurement, but here both are combined with technician labour and call-out. The line is not split, so the higher reference applies.

items.description: Freeing, repair and re-insulation of leaking kitchen sink supply pipe, incl. replacement copper section
items.rationale: Policy covers necessary repair costs for damaged building components (7.1.1(b)), including freeing, repair, and re-insulation of the affected pipe, and replacement of the copper section. The work is confined to the affected part (7.1.5). Reference cases (21, 18) show similar repairs (freeing, repair, re-insulation, copper section) at t between 117-158 and t >= 221, but those included more extensive work or a flat rate for a longer run. Here, the run is 1.5m, which is in line with the lower end of the reference. The line is a single flat rate for all necessary work.

Policy covers one travel, mileage or call-out charge per contractor per invoice (7.1.7(f)). Reference cases (21, 18) show vehicle costs per pcs at t >= 76. This is the only vehicle cost on the plumber's invoice, so it is indemnified.

items.description: Drying of the kitchen floor and wall base, incl. condensation dryer
items.rationale: Policy covers drying, dehumidification, and moisture-removal measures necessary before repair (7.1.7(b)), but only for rooms and building parts in which moisture caused by the insured event has been established (7.1.5). Here, the drying is for the kitchen floor and wall base, which were affected. Reference cases (21, 12) show drying of kitchen floor and wall base at t between 20-148, with condensation dryer at 20-65. This line is a combined flat rate for both, so the upper end of the range applies.
